# ggbank-receipt

> Sign the work your agent did; let anyone verify it offline. Ed25519 receipts over artifacts. No account, no chain, no network.

## What it does
- `issue_receipt`: signs an artifact (sha256) with an agent key, together with task, agent id and amount
- `verify_receipt`: verifies signature, every field, and optionally the artifact hash — offline
- Tampering with a field or a byte of the file fails verification

## Use it
- CLI: `python3 receipt.py keygen|issue|verify`
- MCP: `python3 mcp_server.py` (stdio JSON-RPC, tools: issue_receipt, verify_receipt)
- Agent card: `agent-card.json` · registry manifest: `server.json`

## Limits
- Proves authorship and integrity, not quality or identity of a human
- Python 3.10+, one dependency (`cryptography`), MIT licence

## Repository
https://github.com/ecstatica/ggbank-receipt
